_about: Business-driver backfill queue: the KPI backfill task takes the next 5 tickers from 'todo', fills the last 4 quarterly releases (plus year-earlier figures they state), then moves them to 'done'. 'notes' records KPIs a company does not disclose.

notes.MSFT: Pilot done 30 Oct for Q1 FY26, Q3 FY26, Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27; fill Q2 FY26 and capex history.
notes.GOOGL: Cloud backlog not stated for Q4 2024, Q1 2025. Q1 2026 and Q2 2025 backlog from third-party call transcripts.
notes.AMZN: AWS backlog not stated Q4 2024; backlog from 10-Qs (Q1-Q2 2026) or call transcripts (others). Capex/OCF uses quarterly figures.
notes.V: Q1-Q4 FY26 filled. FY25 growth rates (payments volume, cross-border, processed transactions, VAS) not pulled; VAS growth is constant-dollar from calls only (Q4 FY26 from third-party transcript).
notes.MA: Cross-border and switched transactions growth not stated for Q4 2024-Q2 2025 in sourced releases; VAS growth not stated for year-earlier quarters. Rebates from slide footnotes.
notes.AAPL: Q4 FY26 not yet reported (due 2 Nov 2026). Installed base stated only Q1 FY25 (2.35B) and Q1 FY26 (2.5B). Services gross margin computed from services sales and cost of sales.
notes.NVDA: Q3 FY25-Q2 FY27 filled (Q3 FY27 due late Nov 2026). Top-customer share for Q4 FY25/Q4 FY26 uses 10-K full-year figure (no quarterly figure). Supply-commitment definition changes over time (inventory purchase obligations to Q1 FY26; total purchase commitments Q2 FY26; total supply-related commitments Q3 FY26-Q1 FY27; $279B supply and capacity Q2 FY27), so that series is not like-for-like.
notes.AVGO: Q4 FY24-Q3 FY26 filled. Net debt/EBITDA not available for Q3 FY26: release and call no longer state adjusted EBITDA. AI revenue for Q4 FY24 and Q4 FY25 from call transcripts.
notes.LLY: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled (Q3 2026 reported 29 Oct 2026). Pipeline milestones for the last 4 quarters only. Sourced from investor.lilly.com releases (sec.gov refused).
notes.NFLX: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled. Advertising revenue growth not disclosed quarterly (only full-year statements such as 'more than doubled', '$1.5B+ in 2025'). Content ratio computed from 'Additions to content assets' / amortization.
notes.BKNG: Q3 2024-Q2 2026 filled; Q3 2026 due 3 Nov 2026. Performance/brand marketing no longer split: marketing ratio uses the single 'Marketing expenses' line.
notes.EXPE: Q3 2024-Q2 2026 filled (Q3 2026 due 4 Nov 2026). Take rate = revenue / gross bookings; marketing ratio = direct + indirect selling & marketing / revenue.
notes.CRM: Q3 FY25-Q2 FY27 filled. Data Cloud/AI ARR not stated Q3 FY25; series not like-for-like (renamed Agentforce & Data 360 ARR from Q3 FY26, includes ~$1.1B Informatica from Q4 FY26, Slackbot/Headless 360 from Q2 FY27); several values are 'over'/'nearly'. Net debt = current + noncurrent debt (ex leases) - cash - marketable securities; jump in Q1 FY27 from ~$25B ASR borrowing.
notes.ADBE: Q4 FY24-Q3 FY26 filled. Digital Media ARR no longer reported in FY26 (only Total Adobe ARR, no growth rate), so that KPI uses total subscription revenue growth (computed from income statement) for all 8 quarters. RPO growth mostly computed from RPO $; SBC from cash-flow statement.
notes.INTU: Q1 FY25-Q4 FY26 filled. FY26 segment regroup: Consumer now = TurboTax + Credit Karma + ProTax, so TurboTax KPI uses 'TurboTax revenue' growth in FY26 and old Consumer Group growth in FY25 (not strictly comparable). Online Ecosystem growth includes Mailchimp.
notes.ADSK: Q3 FY25-Q2 FY27 filled. Net revenue retention from earnings slides from Q1 FY26 (releases only define it); text values abbreviate slide wording (exact wording in quotes).
notes.FTNT: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled (Q3 2026 reported 28 Oct 2026). Service revenue growth (Q2 2025-Q3 2026), deferred revenue growth (Q1 2025-Q3 2026) and Q2 2025 product growth not stated as %: computed from income-statement / balance-sheet figures (current + non-current deferred revenue). Q3 2026 release via GlobeNewswire copy (sec.gov refused).
notes.VEEV: Q3 FY25-Q2 FY27 filled (Q3 FY27 due early Dec). RPO not disclosed (10-Q says RPO beyond one year 'not significant'; releases never state RPO), so RPO growth skipped. Operating margin = GAAP operating income / total revenues. Vault CRM text for last 4 quarters only; Q1 FY26 and Q4 FY26 quotes join fragments.
notes.APP: Q3 2024-Q2 2026 filled (Q3 2026 due 4 Nov 2026). Basis changes after 2025 Apps sale: ad growth = Advertising segment to Q1 2025, then total continuing-ops revenue; EBITDA margins Q3 2024-Q1 2025 are restated continuing-ops; FCF from Q2 2025 includes discontinued-ops cash flows. Share change = diluted weighted-average shares y/y.
notes.FICO: Q4 FY24-Q3 FY26 filled (Q4 FY26 due 4 Nov 2026). Q4 FY24 mortgage originations revenue $ not found (only +52% y/y); mortgage $ from investor-presentation slides, rounded to $1M.
notes.VRSN: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled. Q3 2026 renewal rate not yet available (no preliminary rate given; final comes with Q4 2026). Only price change in window: .com $10.26 -> $10.97 from 1 Nov 2026 (announced Q1 2026). Quotes are shortened fragments joined with '...', some reconstructed to standard release wording; Q3 2026 source is a finviz copy of the Business Wire release.
notes.SPGI: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled (Q3 2026 reported 27 Oct 2026). ETF AUM not in releases: from calls for Q2 2026 ($6.35T) and Q3 2026 ($6.5T) only; year-earlier ratings/indices points are $ only. MI organic subscription growth only on calls (Q4 2025 from MarketBeat summary); Q3 2026 skipped (call says 'grew 6% to 7% on an organic basis', ambiguous); year-earlier not stated. Adjusted margin: year-earlier computed from stated bp change; includes Mobility to Q1 2026, ex-Mobility from Q2 2026 (spin-off), so series not like-for-like.
notes.MCO: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled (Q3 2026 reported 21 Oct 2026). MA retention rate not disclosed in quarterly releases (skipped). MA ARR growth for Q4 2024-Q3 2025 not stated in current releases (not collected). Q4 2025 release via Boardroom Alpha copy of the 8-K.
notes.NDAQ: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled (Q3 2026 reported 22 Oct 2026). Leverage is GROSS debt/EBITDA as stated on calls (Q4 2025 2.9x, Q3 2026 2.5x); Q1-Q2 2026 transcripts unreadable, releases give no ratio/EBITDA. ARR growth = reported basis (organic in quote). Solutions organic growth Q4 2024 skipped (organic % not quoted verbatim).
notes.CBOE: Q4 2024-Q3 2026 filled (Q3 2026 reported 30 Oct 2026). Options ADV = Total Company Options ADV. Organic net revenue growth only Q2 2026 (slides) and Q3 2026 (computed from organic table); other quarters not stated (Q4 2025/Q1 2026 slides could not be fetched). Data & Access Solutions renamed Data Vantage; Q3 2026 organic (computed), Q2 2026 organic, others reported growth from CFO remarks; Q4 2024 not disclosed.
notes.FDS: Q1 FY25-Q4 FY26 filled (Q4 FY26 reported 30 Sep 2026). Retention is a floor ('greater than/above 95%') recorded as 95; client-count retention (91%) stated Q1 FY25-Q2 FY26 only. Organic ASV prior-year base restated each year.
